fields.name: Aura AI Assistant
fields.description: Aura is a Django-based AI voice assistant web application that enables users to interact with AI through text and voice. It includes AI-powered conversations, real-time streaming responses, voice input, chat history, and a modern interactive interface.iIt allows the accession by Email verification.

fields.name: Aura_Voice_Assistent
fields.description: A Python-based console voice assistant designed to interact with users through voice commands and perform a variety of useful tasks. Aura provides speech recognition, AI-powered responses, weather updates, date and time information, system details, and basic automation such as launching applications
fields.tech_stack: Python, Speech Recognition, AI APIs, Weather API, System Mon

fields.name: Online Voting System with Admin Control
fields.description: A Java-based GUI application designed to provide a secure and organized digital voting experience. The system allows users to cast votes , prevent them from double voting while providing an admin panel to manage candidates, monitor voting activities, and control the overall election process. This project helped me strengthen my understanding of Java programming, OOP, Event_Handling,GUI development and application logic concepts.
fields.tech_stack: Java, Java Swing, GUI Development, Object-Oriented Programmi

fields.name: Tic-Tac-Toe Game
fields.description: A desktop-based Tic-Tac-Toe game developed using Java Swing. The game provides an interactive graphical interface where players can choose their dice of their own choice. It includes game logic for detecting winners and draws, along with functionality to reset and start a new game.
fields.tech_stack: Java, Java Swing, GUI Development, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Event Handling, Game Logic

fields.name: Rock Paper Scissors Game
fields.description: A Python console-based Rock Paper Scissors game developed to strengthen my understanding of Python fundamentals. The game allows the user to play against the computer while practicing core programming concepts such as user input, conditional statements, loops, randomization, and basic program logic.
fields.tech_stack: Python, Conditional Statements, Loops, User Input, Random Module, Basic Game Logic.

fields.name: KBC (Kaun Banega Crorepati) Quiz Game
fields.description: A Python console-based quiz game inspired by Kaun Banega Crorepati (KBC). The game presents multiple-choice questions, checks the player's answers, and increases the prize amount as the player progresses through different questions
fields.tech_stack: Python, Conditional Statements, Loops, Lists, Dictionaries, Functions, User Input, and Game Logic

fields.name: Java Swing Calculator Application
fields.description: A fully functional desktop calculator application developed using Java and Java Swing. The application provides an interactive graphical interface and performs basic arithmetic operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. It includes buttons for numeric input, operators, clearing the display, and calculating results.
fields.tech_stack: : Java, Java Swing, GUI Development, Event Handling, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Arithmetic Operations, Application Logic

fields.name: Student Contact Form – Java Swing GUI Application
fields.description: GUI-based Student Contact Form developed using Java and Java Swing. The application provides an interactive interface for entering student contact information and display them on another page, such as name and other contact details. It focuses on creating a user-friendly form and handling user input through graphical components.
fields.tech_stack: Java, Java Swing, GUI Development, Event Handling, User Input Handling, Form Design, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

fields.name: E-Voting System – C++ Console-Based Application
fields.description: A console-based Electronic Voting System developed in C++ as an academic project. The system was designed to manage the voting process, including voter interaction, candidate selection, vote casting, vote counting, and displaying election results through a structured console interface.  This project helped me strengthen my understanding of core C++ programming concepts and build a complete application using logical problem-solving and data management.
fields.tech_stack: C++, File Handling, Conditional Statements, Loops, Functions, Input/Output Operations, Data Handling, and Application Logic
